patch_44_typed_hiddenpower_thaw.engine_defect: gen3/generate_instructions.rs thaw-on-fire-hit exclusion lists only Choices::HIDDENPOWER and Choices::WEATHERBALL; the choice vocabulary's 32 typed Hidden Power variants (HIDDENPOWERFIRE60/70 and the other types) slip through, so a typed HP Fire hit thaws a frozen defender unconditionally and lets it act (replayed: ChangeStatus FREEZE -> NONE at 100 percent of branches, defender deals damage the sim never saw)
patch_44_typed_hiddenpower_thaw.sim_rule: gen3 frz.onDamagingHit thaws on this.dex.moves.get(move.id).type === 'Fire'; the runtime id in real games is always the GENERIC 'hiddenpower' (dex type Normal; the typed name is display-only in the request payload), so the sim never thaws on Hidden Power regardless of its IV-derived dynamic type; the parent thawsTarget path also does not apply (typed HP entries carry no thawsTarget flag)
patch_44_typed_hiddenpower_thaw.sim_probes: live gen3customgame (hp_thaw_sim_probes.py): HP-Fire-IV Hidden Power is supereffective on Skarmory (dynamically Fire) yet a frozen Shuckle hit by it keeps frz and answers |cant| (seeds 14, 37); the 20 percent self-thaw arm appears at the defender's own action (seed 40; also a same-turn instance on seed 10), which is the engine's 80/20 gate and is NOT touched; Flamethrower control cures frz immediately after the damage line and the thawed mon acts the same turn (seeds 14, 37 turn 3)
patch_44_typed_hiddenpower_thaw.fix_class: enumerate all 33 HIDDENPOWER enum variants in the exclusion, exactly mirroring the counter-hiddenpower-category patch's 33-variant match arm (patch 40 precedent); the 80/20 freeze gate and the Flamethrower thaw path are untouched
